Q8090.reason: EC/Badinter recognition criteria expressly required respect for the rule of law, democracy and human rights (plus minority guarantees); boundary change and population exchange were rejected, and dispute settlement was framed as agreement/arbitration rather than a general ICJ submission duty.

Q8091.reason: A self-executing treaty is precise enough to be applied domestically without further implementing legislation; transformation and reliance on implementing measures describe the opposite, non-self-executing case.

Q8093.reason: Under VCLT Article 7, treaties are concluded by competent representatives, and heads of state, heads of government, foreign ministers and (for adopting treaty text) heads of diplomatic missions are presumed to have that authority without producing full powers.
